summary: Implemented native video share: shareVideoFile helper with injectable canShare/share seams (AbortError→aborted, files-only probe, MIME-honest WebM), useReplayExport retains File on success with container MIME past download revoke, ReplayTransportBar Share (≥44×44) gated by canShareVideoFile and invoked only on click. 20 related unit tests green; typecheck clean. No server APIs; no auto-share.
goal: After downloading climb replay video, allow sharing via Apple & Android native share sheets (Web Share API files).

learnings.insight: Download blob URL revoke (~1s) is independent of share retention: success status carries a File that owns the bytes; share never uses the revoked object URL. Assembled File.type is container MIME only (video/mp4|video/webm), not the MediaRecorder codec string.
learnings.action: Assert success.file.type is video/webm for WebM label and that canShare/share probes use that type; do not require the download object URL to remain live for share.

learnings.insight: shareVideoFile accepts injectable canShare/share deps; AbortError → reason aborted (non-error UI); non-abort → reason error with non-empty message. canShare probe payload is files-only (no title/text).
learnings.action: Map AC-NS-1/4/5/6/8 to shareVideoFile.test.ts fakes; reject source-text greps for navigator.share; assert bar click path for gesture (ADR-NS-5).

learnings.insight: Native-share implementer pass: 20 production-invoking unit tests green (shareVideoFile 9, exportMime 5, exportVisibility 6); pnpm typecheck clean. Zero new HTTP endpoints or dependencies.
learnings.action: Verifier: extend AC-NS matrix for bar mount/announce and success-transition no-auto-share; nextStage verifier.

notes.climbScene: No prop changes — ReplayExportStatus.success.file flows through existing exportStatus prop
appliedLearnings: Retain File past download URL revoke (architect + product-spec)
Files-only canShare probe; never forge video/mp4 for WebM
Share only from bar click; never from onstop
Invoke production units in tests — no source greps
